original_test_intent: Verify `PWR_CRPS1` and `PWR_CRPS2` are two separately identifiable CRPS power telemetry points and that Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading display the correct supply/feed identity, electrical measurement boundary, quantity, units, status and supported thresholds for the recorded redundancy and load state.
original_method: Define CRPS for the Project, map each name to a fitted PSU/FRU, AC feed and exact PMBus page/command, then query the two records separately and correlate their unchanged UI presentation with boundary- and state-specific specifications. Preserve PSU population, feed, redundancy and system load.
manual_activity: The PSU/power owner defines CRPS1/2, maps both FRUs and their AC feeds/PMBus pages, records the current load/redundancy state and supplies boundary-specific acceptance. Automation can collect passive OOB and UI evidence; a human confirms the operating context and owns the two-point verdict. No PSU service action is part of this row.
required_inputs: Chassis/power-backplane PN/revision, BMC/PSU firmware and authoritative CRPS definition
CRPS1/2 physical slot, FRU PN/serial/model, firmware, AC feed, presence/active-standby role and redundancy map
Per-record electrical boundary—AC input, DC output, load percentage-derived power or other defined quantity—and units
PMBus bus/address/page/command/format/scaling/calibration/averaging window and stable SDR/API/UI identities
Recorded host/GPU/system load, PSU mode, input voltage and cooling condition
Boundary- and state-specific tolerance, limits, thresholds/hysteresis, status, unavailable/stale behavior
Protected supported OOB/API/browser access and pinned reviewed `sensor.git` revision/checksum or approved manual method
safety_requirements: Do not clear SEL, PSU, BMC or host power logs; existing faults and feed transitions are required context.
Do not issue `sensor get 'PWR_CRPS1~2'` as a range. Enumerate and read two exact names with stable FRU/page identities.
Do not infer CRPS1/2 equals PSU1/2 or aggregate the six following PSU records; prove the Project mapping from FRU inventory and the power tree.
Do not compare input and output watts or load percentage-derived power without accounting for efficiency, auxiliaries, power factor and aligned averaging windows.
Do not remove a PSU, switch an AC feed, alter redundancy/load/share mode, change thresholds/policy, reset a controller or flash firmware. Record the existing state only.
Do not expose passwords with `-P`, assume cipher 17, truncate discovery, execute the inaccessible private Script or retry automatically after a missing/faulted/stale supply.
agent_execution_scope: Validate CRPS semantics, two-FRU/feed/PMBus/SDR/UI map, current redundancy/load state, protected client and vendor specification; prepare a two-row expectation matrix.
Read CRPS1 and CRPS2 separately with full FRU, PMBus page/command, electrical boundary, value, units, threshold capability/values, status, sample window and timestamp; capture both unchanged UI rows.
Record concurrent input voltage, AC-feed health, PSU role/share, system/GPU load and cooling; compare only to rules for that exact boundary and state.
Preserve complete raw/redacted evidence without log clear, PSU/feed/load/redundancy/policy/threshold/firmware mutation, automatic retry or DUT verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve what CRPS means on this platform and the CRPS1/2-to-slot/FRU/feed/PMBus map, including its relationship to PWR_PSU1~6.
Supply quantity/boundary/scaling/window, state-specific limits/threshold/status/freshness and absent/standby rules; approve the collection tool or Project Override.
Review both supplies independently and issue the formal verdict without using an aggregate, unmatched PSU channel or changed-load state as substitute evidence.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Unfit as written: IPMI does not expand the tilde range, and one lookup cannot establish two FRU/page-bound records. The fallback may omit either point, reveals a password and assumes cipher support while supplying no electrical-boundary or operating-state comparison.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Resolve two exact CRPS records from complete SDR/FRU/PMBus inventory, query each through protected read-only access and correlate time-aligned raw fields with the exact Dashboard and Server Health rows and approved state-specific specification.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: PWR_CRPS1~2, both UI paths, readability/specification Criteria, generic clear instruction, Script URL, DeepSeek command and 1/0-minute estimates remain preserved; Review expands the shorthand without editing Master or creating a redundancy event.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a two-row matrix keyed by FRU serial, physical slot, AC feed and PMBus page/command; record load/redundancy state and compare complete synchronized raw/UI telemetry with the correct input/output boundary specification.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The exact CRPS/power-backplane population and BMC/PMBus/WebUI implementation documented by the Project.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record chassis/backplane, BMC/SDR/WebUI, CRPS model/firmware, PMBus client and Script revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Project power tree and slot/feed map, CRPS vendor PMBus Application Note or firmware specification, FRU schema, BMC SDR repository and WebUI schema.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Expands the two labels and adds FRU/feed/page/electrical-boundary identity plus synchronized operating-state evidence while preserving passive display coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Static CRPS readings do not validate hot-removal, AC drop, current sharing, failover, load response, overload/protection, efficiency or the six PWR_PSU channels.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: CRPS/PSU mapping, PMBus boundary and scaling, current load/redundancy state, acceptance rules and validated evidence interface.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Redundant supplies may operate active/active or active/standby and report different valid values; input and output measurements differ by efficiency and auxiliary consumption.

project_override_considerations: A Project-approved Redfish/OEM or PMBus vendor interface may replace or corroborate ipmitool only while preserving the original method, documenting reason/interface/version/engineer approval, and proving equivalent separate CRPS1/2 FRU, feed, page, boundary, value, units, thresholds, status and freshness coverage. PWR_PSU1~6 or an aggregate is not automatically equivalent.
expected_evidence: Chassis/power-backplane/BMC identity and approved CRPS definition
Complete separate raw value, electrical boundary, quantity/units, scaling/window, threshold capability/values, status and synchronized timestamp plus redacted Dashboard/Server Health rows
Recorded input voltage, feed health, PSU share/mode, host/GPU/system load and cooling with boundary- and state-specific Project/vendor comparison
Explicit absent/standby/fault/zero/unavailable/stale disposition, protected tool/Script provenance, no-clear/no-PSU-or-load-change/no-retry proof, final PSU/BMC health and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Sensor Page navigation and Criteria consistently ask for passive display/specification verification of two CRPS power records. Their exact expansion, mapping and electrical boundary are underdefined but are ordinary Project readiness inputs, not contradictory purposes.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The two-point CRPS display objective is identifiable. Vendor PMBus documentation and the Project FRU/power map can supply the missing semantics without modifying or servicing the DUT, so the case is not permanently blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Changes unsupported YES to PACKAGE and replaces a literal range with two separately identified FRU/feed/page records.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees with the hybrid classification and strengthens the contract with serial-bound inventory, input/output boundary, current-sharing state and explicit separation from PWR_PSU1~6.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Replaces command-presence reasoning with complete dual-CRPS identity, raw/UI and state-specific specification evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Keeps six-PSU display and CRPS removal/redundancy coverage separate rather than claiming it through these two passive readings.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: No invalid draft exists for this exact source identity.

review_improvement: Prevents an invalid range query, wrong PSU/page mapping, input/output boundary mismatch or legitimate active/standby imbalance from being presented as two CRPS passes, and prevents passive UI inspection from authorizing PSU service.
independent_technical_reasoning: CRPS labels do not themselves identify whether BMC reports AC input, DC output or a firmware-derived load value. Redundant supplies can legitimately divide load unevenly or place one unit in standby. Therefore each reading must be bound to FRU/feed/page and interpreted with the recorded redundancy, voltage and load state; similarity to PWR_PSU channels is not proof of equivalence.
